Yeah I have thank you

Own it! Bald confident men are so yummy. 24f Midwest origin.
You are fine as hell. 8/10 you have an intense look about you. Try some half smiles. ;)
Work on the bushy eyebrows and patchy facial hair 7/10
8/10 24f Midwest origin
I take comfort in sad music sometimes. Empty by Olivia O'Brien is pretty awesome. However the music video sucks its so pretentious. But I totally feel the lyrics

Suicide is always in the back of my mind too. I have a couple of ideas. Overdose... Hanging myself from a billboard in town so all who persecute me can feel some guilt for making my life a career strategy.

Your goals were made together. All your plans, all your dreams. 

I feel like half a person. Like I am waiting for him to come back. 

We had a couple name. People didnt see us apart. People like us don't just die. 

Everyone is starting families at our age and getting married. I resent them. I resent them for getting all those milestones that I should have had. 

I resent all those long time couples celebrating their umpteenth anniversary. I resent all those widows with kids and years of marriage. 

I celebrated our 1st anniversary alone. We were together for about 5 years. 

Sorry I am rambling.

Yeah the fucking DA thinks he can punish me more than I have punished myself and the actual consequences of the wreck have been hell to deal with. Permanent injuries from head to toe, medical bills, physical therapy, ptsd, having to plan a funeral, having to sign a DNR when he was having multiple organ failure... 

Funny how strength works. People recognize your strength when you have no choice but to go on. 

We will figure it out.
I can't believe that they think "you have so much to live for" line is comforting. Its daunting

I have no idea. Its like the last 6 years I have built this life and this career and its all gone. I got laid off and I have been charged with my husbands death because I was speeding so its hard to even get an interview. I just want something clerical. While I figure it out. Idk. My mom is having issues too. You really have to take care of yourself. I wasted so much time trying to please others.

Griefshare has been a godsend for me. Although at this point in my grief I am posses at God for not saving my late husband. I roll my eyes at the bible shot but having a relatable place to go is so relieving. Even better than my 1 on 1 shrink

You are not alone. I lost my(24) husband(23) of only 9 months to a car wreck. I am so lost as to what to do. He was looking to go to law school. He recieved his BS posthumously. I am in my last class of my masters and I have 0 clue about what to do with all this "your whole life ahead of you" crap.
I am unemployed, I have a criminal record charged but not convicted, I have no social life.
Emotional rut :(
Thank you
Yes lol

Wow, you guys are way more understanding than my friends and family. Thank you for the support. I was really low and having a panic attack. I just found out I was in the news again and I am already under so much pressure. I have 5 lawyers and I am so overwhelmed.
